params.name: resData
params.description: BLOB field or variable to receive the data; filled with the contents of the resource.

params.name: resFile
params.description: Resource file reference number to restrict the search to; if omitted, all open resource files are searched.

constraints: If the resource is not found, resData is left unchanged and the OK system variable is set to 0.
If resFile is omitted, the first matching resource found across the chain of open resource files is returned; otherwise only that file is searched.
